kebab_example: aliyun btripopen invoice-modify --third-part-id 340049 --type 1 --title '测试发票' --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InvoiceModify

parameters.help_en:
The invoice type. Valid values:
1: VAT general invoice.
2: VAT special invoice.
10: INVOICE
parameters.help_zh: 类型，1:增值税普通发票,2:增值税专用发票,10:INVOICE
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The tax identification number. This parameter is required when unit_type is set to 1, optional when unit_type is set to 2, and required when type is set to 10
parameters.help_zh: 税号，当unit_type=1时税号必填，unit_type=2时非必填；type=10时必填
parameters.name: tax_no

parameters.help_en:
The entity type. Valid values:
1: enterprise (tax number required).
2: non-enterprise (tax number optional).

Default value: 1. This parameter is not required when type is set to 10
parameters.help_zh: 单位性质：1-企业单位（税号必填），2-非企业单位（税号非必填）。默认为企业单位；type=10时可不传
parameters.name: unit_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the bank where the account is opened
parameters.name: bank_name

parameters.help_en: The third-party ID of the mailing address
parameters.name: mail_third_part_id

parameters.help_en: The customer email address for INVOICE. This parameter is required when type is set to 10
parameters.help_zh: INVOICE 客户邮箱，type=10 时必填
parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en: The INVOICE customer address. This parameter is optional when type is set to 10
parameters.help_zh: INVOICE 客户地址，type=10 时可选
parameters.name: customer_address

parameters.help_en: A header parameter obtained from the "Enterprise access credential" operation (added in the header). In HTTP mode, you can use so_corp_token=value or dtb_corp_token=value in the URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh: header参数 由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用so_corp_token=value或者dtb_corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_so_corp_token

message.description_en: The remarks about the result, such as a description of the result
message.description_zh: 备注，结果的备注，如对结果的说明
message.title_en: 备注，结果的备注，如对结果的说明
message.title_zh: 备注，结果的备注，如对结果的说明

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
success.title_en: 成功标识，由服务端设置，发生异常时为false。结果为null设置为false。
success.title_zh: 成功标识，由服务端设置，发生异常时为false。结果为null设置为false。
